title: Nourishing Irish Semolina Stew
description: A velvety, savory stew that blends semolina flour with hearty vegetables in a slow‑cooked broth, perfect for a comforting Irish dinner.

ingredients.name: leeks
ingredients.notes: 150 g, white and light green, sliced

instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and add 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add diced onion, carrots, celery, and leeks to the pot, and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle in 3 tbsp semolina flour and stir to coat the vegetables, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in 6 cups beef broth, bring to a gentle simmer, and add the bay leaf, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Stir in 1/4 cup dry barley and reduce heat to low.
Cover the pot and let the stew simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
During the last 10 minutes, add 3 tbsp semolina flour again, stirring constantly until the stew thickens to a velvety consistency.
Remove the bay leaf, taste, and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, optionally garnish with fresh chopped parsley.
